## github-moved

repository acme/api has moved on GitHub; update the project's repository URL

## github-moved-item

GitHub says acme/api#7 has moved (renamed repository or transferred issue)

## github-redirect

GitHub answered reading acme/api#7 with a redirect (HTTP 302), which dude does not follow

## github-too-large

GitHub's answer reading acme/api#7 is past the 4 MiB an agent's read may take

## github-rate-reserve

the rest of GitHub's rate limit is kept for delivery: read acme/api#7 later, or work with what you read

## github-rate-reserve-wait

the rest of GitHub's rate limit is kept for delivery: read acme/api#7 in 2m0s, or work with what you read

## github-rate-limited

GitHub is rate limiting dude (HTTP 429): read acme/api#7 later

## github-not-found

GitHub has no acme/api#7, or dude cannot see it

## github-unavailable

GitHub did not answer reading acme/api#7 (HTTP 502): try again later

## github-unreachable

GitHub did not answer reading acme/api: try again later

## github-forbidden

GitHub refused reading acme/api#7 (HTTP 403)

## github-refused

GitHub refused reading acme/api#7 (HTTP 422)

## search-more

2 more match: narrow the query

## whose-task

your task's project

## whose-session

the projects linked to this session
